# Hazards

Fixers that markdownlint ships but that change content. The reduced rule set must leave this
whole file byte for byte as it is.

A hard break with three trailing spaces:   
still the same paragraph.

The complexity is O(ALPHABET_SIZE * N * M) in the worst case.

Visit https://example.com/docs for details.

## Heading with trailing punctuation:

* A star bullet
    * An indented child

First part of a list:

1. One
2. Two

```text
interrupting code
```

2. Continued after the code block
3. Third

Some _underscore_ emphasis and __strong__ text.

#1: a line that only looks like a heading
